About the job
Marchfeld Retail Group is one of Central Europe's leading omnichannel retailers for home, garden and DIY. With 214 stores in Austria, Slovenia, Croatia and Hungary, a fast-growing online shop and around 9,800 colleagues, we generated net sales of EUR 2.3 billion in 2025.

Our long-standing CIO is leaving the company at the end of October for personal reasons. While we run the search for a permanent successor, we are looking for an experienced Interim CIO who takes over the IT organisation immediately, keeps our critical programmes on track and prepares a clean handover.

The situation
- IT organisation of 180 internal FTE plus around 120 external staff from four managed service partners
- Annual IT budget of roughly EUR 95 million (opex and capex)
- SAP S/4HANA Retail migration in progress, first wave (Austria) planned to go live in April 2027
- Exit from our second data centre and migration of around 400 workloads to Microsoft Azure, 40 % completed
- New POS platform being rolled out to all stores by summer 2027
- NIS2 implementation and an ISO 27001 recertification scheduled for spring 2027

What you will do
- Lead the IT organisation as a member of the extended Executive Board, reporting to the CFO
- Stabilise the SAP S/4HANA programme, review plan and budget with the system integrator and take the go/no-go decision for wave 1
- Steer the managed service partners and renegotiate the infrastructure outsourcing contract that expires in June 2027
- Keep the Azure migration and the data centre exit on schedule and within budget
- Chair the IT steering committee and the IT risk committee, report to the audit committee of the Supervisory Board
- Take care of the IT leadership team of eight direct reports and keep key people on board during the transition
- Support the selection of the permanent CIO and hand over in a structured way

What you bring
- 15+ years in IT management, at least 5 of them as CIO, IT Director or Head of IT in a company with more than EUR 1 billion revenue
- A proven track record with large ERP programmes, ideally SAP S/4HANA, and with cloud migrations
- Experience in retail or consumer goods is a strong advantage
- Strong vendor management and contract negotiation skills
- Several interim assignments of comparable scope
- Fluent English; German is a plus as most of our business units work in German, but it is not required
- Presence in our Vienna head office on three days per week; the remaining days can be worked remotely

Our offer
- Interim contract for 12 months, starting as soon as possible and no later than 1 November 2026
- Day rate up to EUR 1,500 plus travel expenses
- Direct contract with Marchfeld Retail Group AG
- A team that is proud of what it has built and wants to keep moving

Please apply via LinkedIn with your CV and a short overview of your most relevant interim assignments. We treat every application confidentially.
